* Helper for accessing features in {@link android.os.UserManager} in a backwards compatible
 * fashion.

methods.name: public static boolean isUserUnlocked(@NonNull Context context)
methods.comment:
* Return whether the calling user is running in an "unlocked" state. A user
     * is unlocked only after they've entered their credentials (such as a lock
     * pattern or PIN), and credential-encrypted private app data storage is
     * available.

methodNames: public static boolean isUserUnlocked(@NonNull Context context)
